description: Convert a public https URL that returns JSON to tidy markdown ($0.005 USDC via x402). https only — http, file, data, localhost, and private IPs are rejected. Caps: 1 MB body, ~10s timeout, max 5 redirects. Requires JSON content-type or a parseable JSON body. Returns JSON { url, final_url, content_type, markdown, warnings }. Provided as is, with no warranty or guarantee of accuracy or fitness. Nothing is stored.

url.description: https URL that returns JSON to convert to markdown. http/file/data/localhost/private IPs rejected.

name: json-to-markdown
